ThingDef.label: immersion-engineering schematic
ThingDef.description: Corroded plates of engineer's drawings: how to keep a sealed hull livable while it sits in hot water, as the Rust Cathedral's own crews did. What it unlocks is not wired yet (SCALD_GALLERY_SCHEMATIC_UNLOCK_1).

ThingDef.label: Cathedral heat-dump log
ThingDef.description: A service log of where the Rust Cathedral vented its waste heat after the collapse. Every entry names the Scald: it re-tapped the crater lake as a coolant sink, dumping heat where a boiling sea makes more heat invisible, and its captured outflow is the Rustwave.
